baseline_models.focus_anchor: The mirrored verb and agent noun at words 2 and 5 place the same خ ل ق act on opposite sides of the أأنتم أم نحن contrast.
baseline_models.mechanism: The origination branch makes the emitted object a test of whether human participation amounts to bringing it into existence or whether that agency belongs to نحن.

activation_trace.role: Bringing a creature into existence supplies both the disputed act and the named creator in the verse's agency contrast.

changed_reading.after: The verse asks whether producing or emitting material is genuinely origination, or whether origination belongs to the one named as creator.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both خ ل ق occurrences can carry specification and completed formation, not only bare existence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Measurement before action and the completion of a balanced visible form widen creation into specifying a viable form and bringing that specification to completion.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring and proportioning make creation an act of specification rather than an undifferentiated start.
Completed and balanced configuration supplies the endpoint toward which the measured act is directed.

changed_reading.before: Create means simply cause to exist.
changed_reading.after: Create can ask who specifies the proportions of the emitted thing and completes its eventual form.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root also names inward constitution and preparedness for an outcome.
baseline_models.mechanism: The question may reach beneath visible production to the object's latent disposition and fitness to develop.

activation_trace.role: Inward nature contributes the unseen constitution that material handling alone does not explain.
Fitness and preparedness supply the latent capacity by which the emitted material can become more than itself.

changed_reading.before: The question concerns who handles or produces a substance.
changed_reading.after: The question can concern who gives that substance its developmental disposition and readiness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding creation claim and the sequence of verification, seeing, knowing, and remembering turn the focus question into an inspectable test of causal attribution.

activation_trace.role: Origination is the agency claim that the surrounding epistemic sequence asks the hearer to test.
The direct claim of bringing the hearers into existence states the proposition tested by the focus contrast.
Truth realized in act frames acceptance as matching the agency claim to what actually occurs.
The attention-command and inquiry branch turns the emitted object into evidence placed before the addressee.
Knowledge as disclosure supplies a known first emergence against which the present claim can be checked.
Recall after inattention makes the test one of recovering an already available causal datum.

structural_cues: The recurring أفرأيتم at 56:58, 56:63, 56:68, and 56:71 repeatedly moves from attention to an agency contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truth, inquiry, disclosed knowledge, and recall; I infer that their sequence audits causal attribution, while a live alternative is that they function only as exhortative prompts.

changed_reading.before: The question asserts a creator-human opposition.
changed_reading.after: The question asks the hearer to verify that opposition by examining the threshold between an observable human act and an unobserved originating result.

context_deltas.mechanism: The emitted seminal material is itself linked to determination, while death is deliberately apportioned and cannot outstrip the speaker; creation therefore spans a measured life trajectory rather than one biological instant.

activation_trace.role: Prior measurement anchors creation as specification of a trajectory and its limits.
Seminal matter from which form is apportioned identifies the humanly emitted material at the start of the trajectory.
Determination carried through to decree links the seed lexically to a measure that emission does not itself set.
Deliberate ordering by measure supplies the governing operation explicitly attributed to نحن.
Loss of life and power marks the terminal boundary included within that measured order.
Not escaping or outstripping a pursuer keeps the terminal boundary under the creator's control.

structural_cues: 56:58 locates the human act at emission, whereas 56:60 places نحن with the measured distribution of death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seminal material, determination, measured ordering, death, and non-escape; I infer one governed trajectory from seed to death, while the alternative is two separate proofs of power.

changed_reading.before: The focus asks who creates the emitted substance at conception.
changed_reading.after: It asks who measures and governs the entire life-course latent in that substance, including the boundary of death.

context_deltas.mechanism: Replacement by counterparts and a new emergence in an unknown mode make completed form a repeatable identity-pattern, with the known first emergence serving as its precedent.

activation_trace.role: Completed configuration anchors the reading in the formed identity whose continuity is at issue.
One thing standing in another's place supplies continuity through replacement.
Likeness supplies the relation by which a replacement can remain answerable to the prior identity.
Bringing a thing newly into being supplies the second realization of the pattern.
The expressly undisclosed mode leaves the new realization open rather than equating it with the present body.
The first beginning supplies the precedent from which a later emergence is inferred.

structural_cues: 56:61's unknown replacement is immediately paired with 56:62's known first emergence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substitution, likeness, new emergence, an unknown mode, and a first beginning; I infer identity-pattern continuity, while a live alternative is simple replacement of one population by another.

changed_reading.before: Creation is a one-time manufacture of the present body.
changed_reading.after: Creation includes the power to realize identity again through a counterpart or form not yet known.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cultivation distinguishes human preparation from actual growth, and the crop can still be shattered or withheld; the parallel reframes emission as preparatory handling rather than sufficient creative causation.

activation_trace.role: Preparedness anchors the question in the seed's latent fitness, which is not identical with the sower's act.
Casting seed and tilling supply the visible preparatory labor analogous to emission.
Causing the crop to sprout and develop supplies the result distinguished from preparatory labor.
Reduction of dry growth to fragments demonstrates that human preparation does not secure completion.
Failure to obtain the desired outcome names the gap between input and realized fruit.

structural_cues: 56:64 repeats the focus verse's exact أأنتم ... أم نحن agency frame with a second humanly handled seed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sowing, growth, shattering, and deprivation; I map crop preparation to emission and crop growth to embryonic realization, while the alternative is that the crop is only a separate analogy of providence.

changed_reading.before: Emitting reproductive material is treated as creating it.
changed_reading.after: Emission is analogous to sowing: a real human input, but not the origination of its readiness, growth, or completed outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The water sequence separates human use from the water's arrival and drinkable quality; by analogy, creation includes furnishing a viable medium and condition, not merely touching or consuming what arrives.

activation_trace.role: Fitness for an end anchors the water analogy in the emitted material's viability.
Water as the actual life-bearing medium supplies the material whose usability depends on more than human consumption.
Taking in liquid supplies the human endpoint of use without explaining the medium's provision.
Delivering something downward supplies the prior provision explicitly contested in the repeated agency frame.
Bitter saline water supplies the counterfactual failure of fitness despite the material still being water.

structural_cues: 56:69 repeats أأنتم ... أم نحن, and 56:70 varies the product's quality while leaving human thirst and use unchanged.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies water, drinking, delivery, and a possible unusable quality; I infer an analogy to the conditions that make emitted material viable, while the alternative is a distinct proof concerning water alone.

changed_reading.before: Creation is the initial presence of reproductive material.
changed_reading.after: Creation also includes making material fit for life by providing the medium, delivery, and quality on which development depends.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humans kindle a fire already latent in the material, whereas the tree is originated and made useful; this sharply distinguishes activating a capacity from creating the capacity-bearing system.

activation_trace.role: Readiness for an outcome anchors the distinction between latent capacity and its human activation.
Kindled fire supplies the visible effect that humans can elicit.
Fire hidden in the fire-stick and then brought out supplies the latent capacity activated by the human act.
Originating the capacity-bearing thing supplies the agency contrasted with kindling.
The actual tree supplies the material system in which the fire-making capacity resides.
Assigning a thing a state or function supplies the endowment of the tree with mnemonic and practical roles.
A useful provision for need makes latent capacity purposive rather than accidental.

structural_cues: 56:71 asks about human kindling, then 56:72 repeats the focus agency frame about originating the tree.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies latent fire, human kindling, origination of the tree, and assigned utility; I infer the same activation-versus-endowment distinction for emitted seed, while the alternative is a separate technology analogy.

changed_reading.before: A human act that releases an effect can be called creation.
changed_reading.after: The focus distinguishes releasing a latent effect from originating the material, readiness, and system that make the effect possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing command converts the accumulated agency contrasts into an act of clearing the named, sovereign nurturer from false equivalence and acknowledging greatness.

activation_trace.role: Origination supplies the divine agency whose recognition is carried into the closing imperative.
Clearing and declaring free from defect turns correct causal attribution into explicit transcendence.
The name as designation makes the response an explicit naming of the agent rather than an anonymous first cause.
Sovereignty and ownership identify the creator as the one with governing authority over the traced processes.
Greatness in power supplies the evaluative conclusion drawn from the repeated limits on human agency.

structural_cues: The imperative at 56:74 closes four أفرأيتم sequences and three explicit أأنتم ... أم نحن contrasts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transcendence, naming, sovereignty, and greatness after the agency tests; I infer that recognition of creative agency causes the liturgical response, while the alternative is a general closing formula.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an abstract causal question.
changed_reading.after: The focus is a causal question whose answer requires correcting worshipful attribution, not merely conceding an explanation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the vocalized construction and dominant branch support physical creation; it remains anchored in the focus root's explicit fabrication branch and the immediate truth-and-inquiry sequence. Render only as secondary wordplay about a manufactured claim of authorship, never as the primary lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: خ ل ق at words 2 and 5 includes the fabrication of false speech as a live but branch-distant possibility.

activation_trace.role: Fabricated speech supplies a secondary sense in which humans may manufacture an account about their own authorship.
Truthful speech supplies the immediate contrast that activates the fabrication branch.
The pointed inquiry exposes the authorship claim to examination rather than letting it remain asserted.

changed_reading.before: The verse disputes only physical production.
changed_reading.after: Secondarily, it may also expose a humanly fabricated story that confuses participation in emission with creative authorship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it activates rare cavity and reproductive-fluid branches from literal water and descent contexts; it remains anchored in the focus root, the explicitly emitted semen, and packet-supplied branch images. Render as a material analogy about containment and development, not as a replacement gloss for تخلقونه.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's water-holding cavity branch can image creation as establishing a receiving and retaining matrix for what humans emit.

activation_trace.role: A cavity that gathers and retains water supplies the image of a matrix that holds generative fluid.
Seminal matter from which form is apportioned identifies the retained substance in the analogy.
Male fluid in the womb supplies the packet's direct bridge from the water sequence back to reproduction.
The exiting male fluid branch cross-activates the descent contrast as movement of generative material.

changed_reading.before: Human emission appears to be the whole material event.
changed_reading.after: The human act expels fluid, while creative agency may be imagined as furnishing the receiving, retaining, and developmental matrix.

strongest_changes: Creation expands from bare origination into measured specification of a life trajectory.
The crop parallel distinguishes human preparation from the growth and completion of a prepared seed.
The fire parallel distinguishes activating a latent capacity from originating and assigning that capacity.
Death, replacement, and first emergence extend the question from conception to continuity beyond the present form.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's doubled خ ل ق frame becomes a reusable diagnostic boundary: humans emit, sow, drink, or kindle, while the context repeatedly relocates origination, viability, growth, transformation, and completion beyond those visible acts.
remaining_uncertainties: Identity-pattern continuity is an inference from replacement, likeness, and renewed emergence; the sequence may instead describe population replacement.
The viability readings depend on mapping the crop, water, and fire mechanisms back to خ ل ق preparedness rather than treating them as independent proofs.
The fabrication and fluid-matrix outliers are branch-valid but should remain explicitly secondary because their lexical distance is substantial.
